❓ HOW TO PLAY
🐦

Keep flying

Tap the screen, press SPACE, or press A on a controller to flap. Every tap gives you a little lift — gravity does the rest.

Collect coins

Coins float between the pipes. Spend them in the Store on hats, trails and power-ups. Some cosmetics only unlock at higher levels.

🌐

Play with others

Hit MULTIPLAYER to join a lobby. Everyone flies the same course, and arrows on the edge of the screen show who is ahead or behind you.

🏆

Climb the ranks

Casual is for fun. Competitive awards rank points based on where you finish — Bronze up to Unreal. Ranked needs at least two players.

👥

Add friends

Share your friend code from the Friends tab. Once they accept you can invite each other to lobbies and jump straight into their game.

🗓️ SEASONAL THEME
They switch on by date on their own — October, December, the week around Easter, and all of March for Flappy Crix's birthday. Forcing one here overrides that for everyone until you set it back to Automatic. 🎂 Birthday starts everyone on the original game; the 🕹️ / switch buttons move between the original and the new one.
👤 JUST FOR ME
Try a season out on your own account without anyone else seeing it. This beats whatever is set above, follows you to any device you sign in on, and does not touch what other players get.
Which parts I see
🎯 COSMETICS
Artwork never lands sitting exactly where the code assumed. Move a hat until it looks right and it is fixed for every player.
Your account only — it grants nothing to anybody else. The point is to be able to wear and fit a cosmetic without waiting for its door.
💰 ECONOMY
🚀 DISTANCE JUMP
Type a distance and send the run straight to it — 0 to 2,147,483,647. Starts a run if one isn't going. Milestones fire as you fly past them, so the −1 presets let the next pipe trigger one.
